description: Snow Parking Bans is a dataset listed in City of Winnipeg open data portal (data.winnipeg.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Winnipeg. Updated list of Snow Parking Bans in effect. Used in conjunction with the Plow Zone Schedule dataset located at. Coverage: Winnipeg. The portal files it under the category City Planning. Its tags are residential, plow, parking ban, devfriendly, zone. The table has 7 columns. The portal shows 2026-05-16 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-winnipeg-ca-portal.
